foundation.name: Synthetic Agency Invoices

problem.value: Choosing which overdue invoice needs attention may take too long

workaround.value: A small unfinished local JavaScript invoice tracker

desiredOutcome.value: See the oldest unpaid overdue invoices first

solution.value: The existing application totals unpaid invoices

constraints: Preserve existing JavaScript modules, manifest and instructions
Local synthetic records only; no reminders or email
unknowns: Whether this ordering helps the owner decide the next manual follow-up
Buyer and willingness to pay are unknown

proposal.title: Show the oldest overdue unpaid invoices for one weekly review.
proposal.journey: Agency owner reads an existing invoice file and sees the overdue unpaid items in date order.
proposal.criticalUnknown: Does oldest-first ordering help the owner choose a useful next follow-up?
proposal.why: Reuse the working invoice data and add only the selection needed for a manual review.
proposal.nextAction: After approval, add an overdue view beside the existing total function.
capabilities: Select unpaid invoices overdue at an explicit review date
keep: JavaScript ESM and existing package scripts
technicalAcceptance: Paid, future and due-today invoices are excluded
Overdue invoices sort oldest first without mutating inputs
learningAcceptance: Later, an agency owner can choose the next manual follow-up; confusion or no useful decision is valid negative evidence
proposal.observationWindow: Review after one synthetic demo, then arrange real exposure separately

intention.statement: A profitable solo business; keep the JavaScript application.

consequence.value: Delays may consume time that could be spent on paid work

brief.summary: Your code totals unpaid invoices; you report no users yet. Slow follow-up decisions are a hypothesis, and usefulness of oldest-first ordering is unknown.
brief.nextAction: Keep the total and add one overdue list.
